nodes.title: Database Models
nodes.content:
# Cyberlearn Data Models

**File Location:** `learning/models.py`

**Database:** SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod)

**Key Concepts:**
- Django ORM
- Foreign Key relationships
- User-related signals
- Content hierarchy: Lesson → ContentBlocks/TaskBlocks

nodes.title: User & Auth Models
nodes.content:
## Django Built-in User Model

**File:** Django auth module

**Fields:**
- username
- email
- password
- first_name, last_name
- is_active, is_staff
- date_joined

**Extended by:**
- UserProfile (OneToOne)
- UserProgress (OneToOne)

nodes.title: UserProfile
nodes.content:
## User Profile Extension

**Relation:** OneToOne → User
**File:** `models.py` line 55-58

**Fields:**
- `user` (ForeignKey)
- `bio` (TextField, blank=True)

**Auto-Created:**
- Signal `create_user_profile` fires on User creation
- Post-save signal `save_user_profile` keeps in sync

nodes.title: UserProgress
nodes.content:
## User Learning Progress

**Relation:** OneToOne → User
**File:** `models.py` line 44-51

**Fields:**
- `user` (OneToOne)
- `level` (CharField) - Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced
- `progress` (JSONField) - Structured data
- `score` (IntegerField) - Total points

**Purpose:**
- Track user's current level
- Store lesson completion status
- Manage user's XP/score

nodes.title: Lesson
nodes.content:
## Learning Unit

**File:** `models.py` line 5-18

**Fields:**
- `title` (CharField) - Lesson name
- `content` (TextField) - Main description
- `difficulty` (CharField)
  - Choices: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced
- `created_at` (DateTimeField) - Auto timestamp

**Relations:**
- OneToMany → ContentBlocks (content_blocks)
- OneToMany → TaskBlocks (task_blocks)

**Purpose:**
- Main learning container
- Organized by difficulty
- Contains educational content

nodes.title: ContentBlocks
nodes.content:
## Lesson Content

**File:** `models.py` line 20-28

**Fields:**
- `lesson` (ForeignKey) → Lesson
- `content_type` (CharField)
  - Choices: 'text', 'code'
- `content` (TextField) - HTML/markdown
- `order` (IntegerField) - Display order

**Purpose:**
- Break lesson into sections
- Support mixed content types
- Control rendering order

nodes.title: TaskBlocks
nodes.content:
## Interactive Tasks/Quizzes

**File:** `models.py` line 30-42

**Fields:**
- `lesson` (ForeignKey) → Lesson
- `question` (CharField) - Task text
- `code_example` (TextField) - Optional code
- `options` (JSONField) - Answer choices
- `correct_answer` (IntegerField) - Index
- `experience` (IntegerField) - XP reward
- `order` (IntegerField) - Display order

**Purpose:**
- Interactive quiz questions
- Multiple choice with code
- Experience/gamification

nodes.title: Note
nodes.content:
## User Notes

**File:** `models.py` line 53-54

**Fields:**
- `description` (CharField) - Note text
- `owner` (ForeignKey) → User

**Purpose:**
- User annotations
- Personal study notes
- Course bookmarks
